meta.name: Primary Field Rig
meta.description: The physical hardware wired into the two-objective board plus one spare prop LED and one spare haptic motor. This file is theme-neutral on purpose - it is reused unchanged by every theme file.
meta._comment: Edit THIS file when you physically add/move/replace hardware. Do not add game meaning here (no 'alarm_led', no 'team_1_led') - that mapping lives in each theme's hardware_aliases block instead, so the same wire can play different roles in different themes.

leds.location_note: Objective A marker, north table position
Objective B marker, south table position
Spare single-color indicator mounted on the control console. Not RGB - single color only, so themes should only ever ask this one for on/off/blink, not a specific color.
leds._comment: This is the LED that plays 'alarm_led' in reactor-meltdown and 'briefcase_led' (RGB fallback: treated as amber-only) in arms-deal. Swap in an RGB module later and just flip supports_rgb to true - no theme file needs to change.

haptics.location_note: Motor embedded in the control console housing
Motor embedded in the spare prop (briefcase / detonator / whatever theme needs a rumbling prop)
